title: Device Code Phishing in Microsoft 365: Attack Analysis
description: In November 2026, a device-code phishing campaign targeted Microsoft 365 users by leveraging payment-themed emails and fake SharePoint workspaces. Attackers used obfuscated HTML and SVG attachments to redirect victims to counterfeit document-sharing pages, where they were tricked into entering attacker-supplied codes into legitimate Microsoft authorization pages. This exploited the device-code authentication flow, allowing attackers to obtain access tokens with granted permissions even after victims completed multi-factor authentication. The campaign employed advanced obfuscation and coordination techniques to evade detection and deceive users into authorizing malicious access.
